# ztna_connector_filters (Data Source)

List Connector Filters



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `field` (String) String that represents a static filter field. Call any of the /filters endpoints without specifying a field to get a list of all available fields.
- `search` (String) String to filter list results by. Is searched over multiple fields in each object. Multiple searches can be specified.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String)
- `total` (Number) Number of values returned.
- `values` (List of String) List of values returned by the API.
